name: @tranzfer/infra
description: Cloudflare infrastructure for Tranzfer, defined in Alchemy.

scripts.dev: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent varlock run -- node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js dev --no-input
scripts.plan: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://tranzfer.app varlock run -- node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js plan --stage production
scripts.deploy: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://tranzfer.app varlock run -- node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js deploy --yes --stage production
scripts.plan:staging: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://staging.tranzfer.app varlock run -- node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js plan --stage staging
scripts.deploy:staging: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://staging.tranzfer.app varlock run -- node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js deploy --yes --stage staging
scripts.plan:preview: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://$ALCHEMY_STAGE.tranzfer.app varlock run -- node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js plan
scripts.deploy:preview: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://$ALCHEMY_STAGE.tranzfer.app varlock run -- node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js deploy --yes
scripts.destroy:preview: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://$ALCHEMY_STAGE.tranzfer.app varlock run -- node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js destroy --yes
scripts.destroy: env -u npm_execpath -u npm_config_user_agent APP_URL=https://tranzfer.app varlock run -- node ./node_modules/alchemy/bin/cli.js destroy --yes --stage production
